label: Wingstop UK "Allergen & Nutritional Information" brand PDF (V7, 16/05/2022), served from the Internet Archive because the live copy of the same wingstop.co.uk URL now 403s
notes: HOW FOUND: www.wingstop.co.uk is an Angular SPA with no macros in HTML. Its allergen page reads download_url from /assets/i18n/en.json, which in the current build points at https://staging.wingstop.sa/content/staging/Allergens/ALLERGEN_INFORMATION.pdf — a Saudi *staging* asset, i.e. the shipped UK build links the wrong file. The real UK document is https://www.wingstop.co.uk/content/wingstop-uk-allergen-info-v2.pdf; that path today returns a CloudFront/S3 403 AccessDenied (object gone) for both plain requests and curl_cffi TLS impersonation, and brute-forcing v3/v4/other filenames under /content/ and /content/prod/Info/ all 403. The Wayback CDX index has exactly one 200 capture of it (20230319072145) and that snapshot is used here. STALENESS WARNING: the document itself is dated 16/05/2022 (V7) — treat these macros as the newest OFFICIAL figures found, not as current. FORMAT TRAP: nutrition is transposed — one product per column block, with rows Energy/Fat/.../Protein/Salt, and column 1 is always Per 100g with the remaining columns per-serving. generic_pdf.fetch_from_pdf returns 0 rows because there is no product-name column. Several pages carry TWO product blocks side by side; these are split by cropping the page at width/2. Detect the block count from the line starting "Nutritional Information" (counting occurrences of that phrase in the whole page text is wrong — the page footer repeats it). 84 rows parsed, 83 kept after dedupe; plausibility check protein*4 <= kcal*1.15 removed 0 (1 dropped as a duplicate name+basis). STILL OPEN: the live ordering API base is https://nomnom-prod.wingstop.co.uk/api (found in chunk-QKOB7SFS.js, envName wingstopuk-prod, tenant wingstopuk; second base https://prod-api.wingstop.co.uk). Every path tried (/restaurants, /restaurants/byslug/..., /menu, /products, /v1/*) answers {"message":"route not found"} or a 503 listener page, so the correct route/headers were not identified. Playwright could not be used to observe the real calls — Chromium gets ERR_CONNECTION_RESET through this environment's proxy.
